assumptions: Human motions are first retargeted to the target robot morphology.
The feasibility policy uses controller and termination boundaries representative of the final tracking stack.
robots: Unitree H1 in the H2O setup
simulators: Isaac Gym / PhysX in the official implementation

confidence_rationale: The paper includes controlled filtering and data-size ablations plus broad H1 demonstrations, and the pinned official repository exposes per-sequence closed-loop evaluation and failure-driven motion sampling. Confidence is capped because filtering thresholds and real-world robustness are tied to one robot/control stack and long-duration safety statistics are not reported.

evidence.locator: Figure 4, Tables III-IV, and Section IV
evidence.note: Connects SMPL-to-H1 retargeting, privileged sim-to-data filtering, robust policy training, and reported real H1 teleoperation.

evidence.locator: LeggedRobot reference-motion evaluation; OnPolicyRunner.run_eval_loop and update_training_data at commit 750f1fa
evidence.note: Maps closed-loop sequence evaluation, early termination, and failure-focused sampling to public implementation symbols.

question: 人体动作完成运动学重定向后，为什么还要用闭环控制器做 sim-to-data 筛选？
statement: 在 H2O 的 H1 管线中，特权运动模仿器逐条闭环跟踪重定向动作并过滤失败序列，比只做运动学阈值清洗更能暴露接触、惯性和控制带宽造成的不可行标签；该机制值得作为训练前数据门，但其通过结果不能外推为另一机器人或实机安全保证。
